1.title: Kanye West announces tour dates in Russia
1.summary: The musician would be the first major Western artist to play Russia since the invasion of Ukraine.

2.title: Florida Primary Underscores State’s New Identity as a Republican Juggernaut
2.summary: Republicans hold every statewide elected office and have drastically swung voter registration in the state. A newly gerrymandered congressional map has added four Republican-leaning seats.

3.title: Searching for Answers From the Man Accused of Sabotaging Alaska’s Senate Race
3.summary: Dan Sullivan, a retired schoolteacher from tiny Petersburg, Alaska, shares a name with the incumbent senator he hopes to defeat. Is he a spoiler trying to divide the Republican vote? We traveled to Alaska to find out.

4.title: Zambia's Hichilema re-elected president as main rival in hiding over alleged threats
4.summary: Hakainde Hichilema says he was “truly humbled” by the victory and promised to work for all Zambians.

5.title: Six Years in Provence: An Ancient Castle and a Feud Over a Troublesome Bridge
5.summary: In a picturesque village, the mayor closed a road, setting off a storm with residents and the owners of a castle that once belonged to his family.

6.title: How Israel’s Financial Chokehold Is Stifling the West Bank Economy
6.summary: Intensifying restrictions have hit every part of the territory’s dealings, spurring worries about whether the Palestinian Authority can remain solvent.
